title: Image Tag Input
summary: Reads a container image reference back the way Docker resolves it, so :latest, moving tags or a typo'd registry don't deploy the wrong image.
description: Image reference field showing the implied docker.io/library/ and :latest, flags :latest or no tag in production, moving tags, typo'd or frozen registries, private images that fall back to Docker Hub, malformed digests and arch-specific tags, with fixes such as pinning a digest.
catches: :latest or a missing tag for production
Moving tags such as stable or main
Private image names that would resolve to Docker Hub
Malformed digests and arch-specific tags that won't run on the target platform
limits: Parses the reference; it does not query a registry unless you pass resolveDigest
Registry typo and moving-tag lists are heuristics
Doesn't scan the image for vulnerabilities or verify signatures
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid on errors and is described by the readback and issues
Implied parts carry a title explaining they are implied
Issues use role=status; focus returns to a nearby control after a fix
server: Pin digests and enforce allowed registries with admission policy in the cluster or CI.
stops: Helps prevent a deploy pulling the wrong image
